# Derek Kaneshiro

> Personal site of Derek Kaneshiro, a principal software engineer. Ten years owning a
> HIPAA-regulated clinical platform serving 500,000+ patients; also builds AI agent and
> evaluation infrastructure, including the open-source framework Synthetic Test Fabric.

## About

Derek Kaneshiro is a principal software engineer based in Hillsboro, Oregon. He spent ten
years as principal engineer on the platform behind Zimmer Biomet's orthopedic recovery
products — a HIPAA-regulated system serving 500,000+ patients — building its rules-driven
care-plan engine, its centralized authorization model, and the R&D that prototyped Claude
and Semantic Kernel integrations through Architecture, Cloud, Security and risk governance.

He also builds AI agent infrastructure: narrow composable sub-agents, MCP tool surfaces,
and multi-provider routing selected per workload on accuracy, latency and cost.

## Work

- Synthetic Test Fabric — open-source evaluation framework for AI systems (MIT, on NPM).
  Ships fab-mcp, an MCP server. https://github.com/kaneshir/synthetic-test-fabric
- Redy — EU Digital Product Passport platform. Publicly released.
- BlueSkil, Toknize — in active development.
